timeline.summary: Mold-Tek Packaging Limited’s Board of Directors, led by Harshita Suresh Chandnani, declared ₹2 interim dividend (40% of ₹5 face value) per equity share for FY2025-26 on April 20, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹237.86 Cr (+17.4% YoY), net profit ₹20.64 Cr (+26.9% YoY).
Mold-Tek Packaging reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹237.59 Cr and PAT of ₹20.64 Cr, driven by robust volume growth across major segments.
Mold-Tek Packaging reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹237.86 Cr and PAT of ₹20.64 Cr on May 11, 2026.
Mold-Tek Packaging Limited uploaded Q4FY26 conference call audio on May 11, 2026, discussing results.
Mold-Tek Packaging hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on May 15, 2026, guiding for FY27 revenue above ₹1,000 Cr and EBITDA of ₹210 Cr.
Mold-Tek Packaging Limited held Q1FY27 earnings call on July 27, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹300 Cr, up 46% YoY, with EBITDA/kg rising to ₹46.7
